fields.System.Title: Upload a file
fields.System.Description:
As an admin, I want to upload a CSV file of customers, so that I can import them without typing them in.
Managers can also start imports.
fields.Microsoft.VSTS.Common.AcceptanceCriteria:
1. Given a CSV file of up to 5,000 rows, when the admin uploads it, then the column mapping step opens.
  2. Given a file with more than 5,000 rows, when it is uploaded, then it is rejected.
  3. The rejection message names the row limit.

comments.text: Can the admin drag a file onto the page?
Yes, both drag and drop and the file picker.
